summary: The solver correctly localized the problem to lv_gif.c and made meaningful edits to initialize header fields (magic, flags, stride, data_size). However, the solver missed the required type change in lv_gif.h from lv_draw_buf_t to lv_image_dsc_t, which the oracle verifier correctly detected via compilation failure.
evidence: Solver read lv_gif.c, lv_gif.h, gifdec.h and related headers during exploration
Solver applied edit to lv_gif.c adding header field initialization (magic, flags, stride, data_size, unaligned_data)
Solver never modified lv_gif.h to change imgdsc type from lv_draw_buf_t to lv_image_dsc_t

Oracle verifier error message clearly indicates the type mismatch: 'initialization of lv_image_dsc_t * from incompatible pointer type lv_draw_buf_t *'
